verdict.rationale: Glama documents exposing a local MCP server through a public tunnel with mcp-proxy, but only so it can be tested in the browser inspector (glama-docs-7, glama-docs-12). The managed Gateway features (logging, access control, credential management) are only described for servers deployed to Glama from the registry (glama-docs-15, glama-docs-28), not for tunneled local servers. missing for 10: evidence that a tunneled local server can be registered as a persistent managed remote connection behind the Gateway, docs on bridge setup and lifecycle, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
